d: A small, youthful figure with a petite build, featuring vivid orange hair styled into flickering, flame-like shapes that flow upwards. The eyes are a bright, glowing yellow with a wide, innocent expression. The figure wears a simple, form-fitting orange dress that blends into the surrounding flames, paired with a small white collar. This entity is composed entirely of living fire, surrounded by swirling currents of orange and yellow flames and floating shards of dark grey rock. BODY COLOR: orange
